what: Pinned outside datasets. The check tools/hf-pins.test.mjs reads this file; it never fetches the network. Only the explicitly labelled --refresh command in tools/hf-pins.mjs contacts huggingface.co, at a fixed commit.

library.used: The pin format is modelled on the datasets library's own dataset cards; no code from the library is vendored.

datasets.author: AWeirdDev
datasets.why: A permissive airport code set the travel floor can name as a checked source; the library's Apache-2.0 licence does not make every dataset free, so this dataset's own MIT card is recorded here.
